steps.title: Fix the roof
steps.done_text: No more drafts! The cottage feels sheltered again.

steps.title: Light the hearth
steps.done_text: The hearth crackles softly. Warm light fills the room, and smoke curls from the chimney.

steps.title: Repair the window
steps.done_text: Sunlight, and at night a warm glow, shines through the new window.

steps.title: Build a bed
steps.done_text: A soft bed! Sleep here to rest until morning (your journey is saved).

steps.title: Restore the workbench
steps.done_text: The old workbench is steady again. It can make finer things.

steps.title: Set up the cooking pot
steps.done_text: A cooking pot hangs by the hearth, ready for recipes.

steps.title: Build a storage chest
steps.done_text: A roomy chest. Crafting nearby can use what's inside.

steps.title: Build a bookshelf
steps.done_text: A bookshelf for your journal, notes and collections.
